notes:
### Check Lock Single-Flight

- Timed Dorcel Check Lock recovery is now single-flight: while one restore attempt is active, additional watchdog passes wait instead of spawning overlapping PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE resolver and player-open attempts.
- The existing opaque black handoff curtain now covers the full Check Lock restore interval and remains in place until the expected replacement player has stable video.

### Extreme Post-Recovery Sync Escape

- After a confirmed Dorcel source return, an extreme ActiveAE A/V-sync debt of at least 30 seconds may use a validated HTTP-healthy replacement as soon as it reaches the existing 25-second / four-segment base maturity.
- This exception is limited to the damaged post-recovery state. Normal five-minute SOURCE_WINDOW stalls cannot trigger it, and the normal second progression sample remains required outside that case.

### Streaming Stability

- Normal SOURCE_WINDOW handling, expiry timing, background standby timing, live delay, timeline protection and the established PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE route remain unchanged from v1.157.
- No local HLS proxy/fallback and no direct child-HLS player path are introduced.

### Important

- Timed manual Stop logging and the v1.156 2 h Stop / Unlimited / Timeout behavior remain unchanged.
- The existing expiry-aware planned refresh remains enabled.
